research.name: Improved Smelting
research.effect: Refineries get 20% more metal from every load of ore.
research.description: Better furnace control and slag recovery pull more metal out of every load. Refineries get 20% more duranium and tritanium from the same ore, so each crawler load goes further.

research.name: Ore Conveyors
research.effect: Mines, deep-core mines and refineries work 20% faster.
research.description: Automated conveyor lines move ore from the drill heads into storage and from storage into the smelters, without crews hauling it by hand. Mines, deep-core mines and refineries all work 20% faster.

research.name: Preventive Maintenance
research.description: Inspection rounds and replacement schedules catch worn parts before they fail. Every building wears 30% slower, so breakdowns are rarer and the crew is needed less often.

research.name: Automated Maintenance
research.effect: Maintenance drones fix any building below 70% without a crew (repairs still take spare kits).
research.description: Small maintenance drones patrol your bases and repair any building that drops below 70% condition, without waiting for the crew. Repairs still take spare kits.

research.name: Alloy Metallurgy
research.effect: Alloy Foundries work 25% faster and get 10% more parasteel.
research.description: Refined alloy recipes and better crucibles for parasteel production. Alloy Foundries work 25% faster and get 10% more parasteel from each batch.

research.name: Reinforced Drills
research.effect: Mining crawlers break down half as often.
research.description: Tougher drill strings, shock mounts and better cooling for the mining crawler's rig. Crawlers break down half as often while mining.

research.name: Deep-Core Mining
research.effect: Unlocks the Deep-Core Mine: reopen a used-up deposit once at 50%.
research.description: Drilling techniques that reach past the depleted upper layers of a deposit. Unlocks the Deep-Core Mine, which reopens a used-up deposit once at half its original size.
